There is no changelog @Haroenv :) Can you explain the bump of version?

> the peerdependencies now include react 16

This might be an issue since we're not using React 16 in IS.js...
it's a peerDependency, and only for the tests. They already include 14, 15, but now also 16, is that right @vvo?
I have the feeling that this version bump adds a lot to the console of tests though, are we using React.PropTypes in react-to-jsx-string?

The bump embarks the new version of react-element-to-jsx-string. https://github.com/algolia/react-element-to-jsx-string/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md

Most of the time that's output differences only. Are there still tests not using Jest snapshots in IS.js?

@vvo I think there are still a few that use toExpectJSX

EDIT: 15 use it: [search 🔍 ](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/search?q=toEqualJSX&type=Code&utf8=✓)
